text:
katie: quick sync — need partner signoff on the driver/CUDA/ROCm matrix and joint announcement wording for the Marketplace listing of Dedicated 0.9.2 hotfix. Targeting Tue 2026-03-24 EOD PT. Who can own final driver matrix + regression signoff?

raj: I can own the matrix and run the smoke/regression suite. Will need hw partner verification for ROCm builds. @maria can you chase the partner point-of-contact? :eyes:

maria: @raj yep, I'll ping our partner contacts. Proposed locked versions to start: NVIDIA 535.86, CUDA 12.2.1, AMD ROCm 6.2.0. I put a quick table in the doc: https://redwood.internal/s/partner-matrix (shared).

oliver: heads up — OEM wants no mention of any "beta kext" wording. They prefer: "validated on partner images" only. Also insist we include a succinct rollback plan in the release notes.

katie: good call. i'll draft announcement copy with that phrasing. raj — can you paste the minimal driver matrix snippet here so partners can sign off quickly?

raj: sure, pasting minimal matrix for quick approval:

```
os|component|version
---|---|---
ubuntu-22.04|nvidia-driver|535.86
ubuntu-22.04|cuda|12.2.1
centos-8|rocm|6.2.0
ubuntu-20.04|nvidia-driver|535.86
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled smoke-tests: nightly 2026-03-23 02:00 UTC, canary run 2026-03-24 06:00 UTC :rocket:

oliver: if any ROCm regression shows up in canary, we default to the marketplace doc that omits ROCm until partner pushes the patch. Confirm?

maria: :thumbsup: I'll confirm with partner legal on the embargo window and the exact phrasing. Also putting a small checklist into the shared doc: partner signoff, legal ok, regression matrix green, canary green, JAR (joint-approval record) signed.

katie: plan summary: 1) raj runs smoke/reg suite, 2) oliver verifies partner wording, 3) maria gets partner signoff/legal, 4) katie publishes draft announcement + release notes (with rollback snippet), 5) deploy-bot runs canary. Who's final approver for the joint announcement?

sre-oncall: i'm final approver for operational rollout. raj please ping @sre-oncall when canaries are green — I'll sign off on rollback plan readiness.

katie: thanks all — i'll update the doc and ping #release-war-room when draft is ready. marking action items in the doc now :calendar:
